ideas.pitch: An automated evaluation platform that scores and validates early-stage student hackathon ideas against market need, technical feasibility, and business viability using multi-agent LLM analysis.
ideas.title: VeriGrant: AI-Powered Startup Idea & Feasibility Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core evaluation themes of the Nexus InnovateX 2026 challenge (idea validation, market understanding, and business fundamentals), making it deeply meta and appealing to the judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized, multilingual web application that offers pre-clinical health triage, preventive care guidance, and vaccination schedules for underserved populations.
ideas.title: HealthTriage AI: Multilingual Rural Symptom & Outbreak Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven winning pattern of creating concrete social impact combined with accessible, localized medical triage that judges love to see for real-world problem solving.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first browser extension and agent that listens to live web audio and warns elderly users in real-time about emerging online scams and phishing schemes.
ideas.title: ElderShield Agent: Voice-First Scam Prevention Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge voice and agentic workflows with a high-stakes real-world security use case, providing a stellar live demo for a video pitch.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition application that generates customized meal plans, tracks dietary habits, and offers personalized lifestyle adjustments based on user health parameters.
ideas.title: NutriPlan AI: Automated Smart Meal & Wellness Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of past wellness hackathon winners by offering an immediately testable consumer-facing product with clear visual metrics and practical value.

ideas.pitch: A smart platform that ingests unstructured pitch videos or lecture recordings, transcribes them, extracts key insights, and makes them instantly searchable via natural language queries.
ideas.title: VidSearch AI: Unstructured Video Intelligence & Knowledge Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles heavy data processing and practical enterprise utility, fulfilling the hackathon's requirement of exploring practical applications of AI and emerging technologies.
